sentences.text: 1. This CRLMP has been filed for a direction to Opposite Party No.2 and 3 to register the written information under Annexure-1 as FIR.

2. Instruction dated 30.01.2026 of the SI, Tigiria Police Station has been received, where it has been stated that on the written report of the petitioner, Tigiria PS Case No. 23 of 2026 has been registered on 29.01.2026 under Section-341/294/376(2)(n)/312/109/420/506/34 of the IPC read with Section 6 of POCSO Act against Mohammad Safiq and two others.
3. In view of the above developments, no direction is required to be issued in the CRLMP, which is accordingly disposed of.
